name: Qwen3-0.6B
baseRepoNote: Transformers id of the post-trained instruct checkpoint the published live GGUF was converted from. This is the live pin's source, not the training base. Qwen3-0.6B-Base is the pretrained checkpoint and is not this pin.
trainBaseRepoNote: Training base only. Kept as its own field so the live pin is never implicitly retrained, even when the two point at the same repo. The live evaluator pin remains fileName/sha256 below (Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 at template v2.1). Do not treat this field as the published pin. History: a LoRA of Qwen3-0.6B hit what looked like a capacity ceiling across six gated checkpoints, so this field was moved to Qwen3-1.7B as a within-family capacity A/B. The 1.7B sweep landed within noise of the 0.6B sweep, which ruled out capacity and identified corpus register narrowness as the real bottleneck. With a register-augmented corpus in hand, training returns to 0.6B, which is also the phone-deployment target.
notes: Reference pin for the on-device semantic evaluator. Fetched as published by the model vendor from Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF, quantization Q8_0, no local conversion. The reference judge's weights must be obtainable and hash-verifiable by anyone from a public source. A locally converted quantization has no provenance outside the machine that produced it. SHA-256 was computed from the downloaded artifact. Validated against prompt template v2.1 (per-class binary decomposition, grammar-constrained yes or no, shared-prefix KV reuse).
